title: Terms of Service
introduction: These terms cover the browser-based tools. Read the format and size limits for the tool you use, and check downloaded results before replacing an original.
seoDescription: Terms for using FileCompresser’s browser-based compression, conversion and ZIP tools, including file responsibilities and processing limits.

sections.heading: What this site provides
body: FileCompresser offers browser-based compression, conversion and ZIP tools. Public tool use does not require an account. Use them only with files you own or have permission to process.

The service is provided as-is. We do not promise uninterrupted availability, and we do not guarantee any particular compression ratio or output quality — the honest limits are described in the Disclaimer.

sections.heading: Your files and your backups
body: The application processes selected files locally and does not hold a server copy from which to restore them. Inputs and results can remain in the open tab until you remove them. Downloads that you save remain on your device. You are responsible for keeping backups of original files before processing.

sections.heading: Processing limits
body: Accepted formats, per-file sizes and available settings differ by tool. The queue limit is 500 files and 300 MiB in total. Browser memory, codec support and file complexity can prevent processing below those limits. Media jobs have a five-minute processing limit.

Ordinary compression can retain the original with no reduction. Explicit conversions and ZIP creation can increase bytes. PDF optimization does not downsample embedded images, and image resizing is not offered. The interface reports actual outcomes; the Disclaimer explains further technical limits.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
body: Do not use these tools for unlawful content, or to circumvent security controls or access restrictions.
Do not attempt to extract or abuse the processing engines, or to use this site to process content you have no right to process.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
body: Your files remain yours. We claim no rights over the content you process. The open-source engines these tools run under (FFmpeg, fflate, pdf-lib, MozJPEG and Oxipng) remain under their own licences.

sections.heading: Changes
body: These terms may be updated as the site changes. The date at the top of this page reflects the most recent revision.

sections.heading: About this document
body: These terms were written for this specific service rather than copied from a template, but they have not been reviewed by a qualified lawyer. They are written in plain English and describe what actually happens when you use the site. If you need terms you can rely on for a commercial arrangement, have a lawyer review these before you rely on them.
